home_page.title: Fibase Admin - Home
home_page.description: Welcome to Fibase, your all-in-one platform for managing registered applications and currencies. Explore our dashboard to view app details, manage activation status, and securely access public and private keys used for system integrations. Stay organized and in control with Fibase's powerful features designed to streamline your application and currency management needs.

login_page.title: Fibase Admin - Login
login_page.description: Sign in to your Fibase Admin account to manage registered applications and currencies. Access powerful features to view app details, manage activation status, and securely access public and private keys for system integrations. Stay organized and in control with Fibase's all-in-one platform designed for efficient application and currency management.

two_factor_login_page.title: Fibase Admin - Two Factor Login
two_factor_login_page.description: Secure your Fibase Admin account with two-factor authentication. Enter the OTP code sent to your registered email or phone number to complete the login process. Enhance your account security and protect your application and currency management with Fibase's robust authentication features.

logout_page.title: Fibase Admin - Logout
logout_page.description: You have been logged out of your Fibase Admin account. We hope you had a productive session managing your registered applications and currencies. If you need to access your account again, simply sign in with your credentials. Thank you for using Fibase, your all-in-one platform for efficient application and currency management.

dashboard_page.title: Fibase Admin - Dashboard
dashboard_page.description: Welcome to the Fibase Admin Dashboard, your central hub for managing registered applications and currencies. Explore detailed insights, view app details, manage activation status, and securely access public and private keys for system integrations. Stay organized and in control with Fibase's powerful features designed to streamline your application and currency management needs. Navigate through the dashboard to efficiently oversee your resources and make informed decisions for your organization.

registered_app_page.title: Fibase Admin - Registered Applications
registered_app_page.description: Manage your registered applications with ease using the Fibase Admin platform. View detailed information about each application, including app details, activation status, and securely access public and private keys for system integrations. Stay organized and in control with Fibase's powerful features designed to streamline your application management needs. Navigate through the registered applications page to efficiently oversee your resources and make informed decisions for your organization.

currency_page.title: Fibase Admin - Currencies
currency_page.description: Efficiently manage your currencies with the Fibase Admin platform. View detailed information about each currency, including currency properties, assigned applications, and default currency behavior. Stay organized and in control with Fibase's powerful features designed to streamline your currency management needs. Navigate through the currencies page to efficiently oversee your resources and make informed decisions for your organization.

payment_method_page.title: Fibase Admin - Payment Methods
payment_method_page.description: Efficiently manage your payment methods with the Fibase Admin platform. View detailed information about each payment method, including payment method properties, assigned applications, and default payment method behavior. Stay organized and in control with Fibase's powerful features designed to streamline your payment method management needs. Navigate through the payment methods page to efficiently oversee your resources and make informed decisions for your organization.

payment_provider_page.title: Fibase Admin - Payment Providers
payment_provider_page.description: Efficiently manage your payment providers with the Fibase Admin platform. View detailed information about each payment provider, including provider properties, assigned applications, and default provider behavior. Stay organized and in control with Fibase's powerful features designed to streamline your payment provider management needs. Navigate through the payment providers page to efficiently oversee your resources and make informed decisions for your organization.

payment_provider_config_page.title: Fibase Admin - Payment Provider Configurations
payment_provider_config_page.description: Efficiently manage your payment provider configurations with the Fibase Admin platform. View detailed information about each payment provider configuration, including configuration properties, assigned applications, and default configuration behavior. Stay organized and in control with Fibase's powerful features designed to streamline your payment provider configuration management needs. Navigate through the payment provider configurations page to efficiently oversee your resources and make informed decisions for your organization.

payment_provider_method_page.title: Fibase Admin - Payment Provider Methods
payment_provider_method_page.description: Efficiently manage your payment provider methods with the Fibase Admin platform. View detailed information about each payment provider method, including method properties, assigned applications, and default method behavior. Stay organized and in control with Fibase's powerful features designed to streamline your payment provider method management needs. Navigate through the payment provider methods page to efficiently oversee your resources and make informed decisions for your organization.

currency_payment_provider_method_page.title: Fibase Admin - Currency Payment Provider Methods
currency_payment_provider_method_page.description: Efficiently manage your currency payment provider methods with the Fibase Admin platform. View detailed information about each currency payment provider method, including method properties, assigned applications, and default method behavior. Stay organized and in control with Fibase's powerful features designed to streamline your currency payment provider method management needs. Navigate through the currency payment provider methods page to efficiently oversee your resources and make informed decisions for your organization.
